decision.observation: The big red boulder fills the right side of the view; to its left, open sand runs between palm trunks and the dark mountain cliff above a grass strip. Morning sky pink at left.
decision.hypothesis: The beach corridor continues to the left of the boulder, flanked by the cliff. Following it inland should lead toward the mountain base and the climb.
decision.memory: Boulder blocks right; pass on its left along the sand between palms and cliff.
